properties.design_role: park and open-space carrier for midday comfort routes and rain/heat refuge discussion
properties.spatial_rule: Planting and shade are a reservation adjacent to, never inside, the pedestrian clear zone; actual canopy, cooling and drainage conditions require field verification.
properties.ai_off_rule: Comfort and orientation remain physical public-space responsibilities when AI heat or rain prompts are unavailable.
properties.jingzhang_design_rule: A durable, maintainable open-space carrier supports the corridor's long-term public reliability.
